department_name: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department
department_name_hindi: सामाजिक न्याय एवं दिव्यांगजन सशक्तिकरण विभाग
description: The department dedicated to upliftment, social security, and economic protection of vulnerable groups including senior citizens, persons with disabilities (Divyangjan), destitute individuals, widows, and marginalized communities.
sub_divisions: State Commissionerate for Persons with Disabilities
primary_functions: Execution of social security pensions including Old Age Pension, Disability Pension, and Widow Pension
Implementation and database maintenance of the Samagra Portal (Single Citizen ID Framework)
Provision of assistive devices, rehabilitation, and equal opportunity schemes for Divyangjan
Supervision of old age homes, rehabilitation centers, and homes for destitute women and children
Implementation of Chief Minister's social welfare initiatives including mass marriage schemes
key_services_offered: Samagra Family ID and Member ID creation, updating, and e-KYC verification
Application processing for Social Security Pension Schemes (Indira Gandhi & State Pensions)
Issue of Unique Disability ID (UDID) cards and assistive equipment allocation
Financial assistance under Chief Minister Kanya Vivah / Nikah Scheme
